card.profile: Street dance is an umbrella term for a large number of social dance styles such as: breakdancing, popping, locking, house dance, waacking, voguing, Hip Hop, etc. Social dance styles have many accompanying steps and foundations, created organically from a culture, a moment in time, a way of life, influenced by natural social interaction. A street dance is a vernacular dance in an urban context. Vernacular dances are often improvisational and social in nature, encouraging interaction and contact with spectators and other dancers.

steps.name: The Funky Bounce
steps.description: Hands on right knee bouncing up and down twice, then repeat on left

steps.name: The Criss Cross
steps.description: Jump feet cross in middle with right in front, then jump out to the side

steps.name: The Funky Scoop
steps.description: Scoop low to the side and bring it into the chest, alternating sides

steps.name: The Electricity Wave
steps.description: Wave arms through wrist, elbow, shoulder, body, and flick out

images: Electricity running through your arm and body
common_mistakes: Not going low then high on the bounce
Standing too straight on the wave arm movement
lessons.teacher_style: The teacher is energetic and enthusiastic, encouraging family participation with friendly, upbeat instructions. She breaks down movements into simple steps and demonstrates them at a steady pace before combining them with music.
lessons.distinctive_method: Framing the tutorial as a family dance vlog inviting parents and kids to join in together.

evidence.observation: Teacher demonstrates hand placement on knee with alternating knee bounces
evidence.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution on back foot

evidence.observation: Jumping with crossed legs and uncrossing to wide stance

observation.setting: Large indoor arena stage with glossy floor featuring a Red Bull logo, surrounded by a seated audience and cameras.
observation.dancers: Individual male dancers competing solo in turn, wearing casual streetwear.
observation.formation_and_space: Solo dancer in the center of the stage facing the judges and audience.
observation.posture: Athletic and upright with bent knees, shifting weight quickly between feet.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping, slides, quick shuffles, and foot drops synchronized with the beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing, pump, or gesticulate dynamically; occasionally arms support body weight during floor transitions.
observation.hips_and_torso: Bends, bounces, and isolations in the torso coordinated with footwork and floor moves.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent changes in levels from upright dancing to floor drops, knee spins, and jumps.
observation.costume_and_props: T-shirts, loose trousers, and sneakers; no hand props.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact subtlest nuances of foot articulation due to wide camera angles and rapid movement.
